note: Licensed music for the film. The MP3s are fetched into public/audio/music/ by scripts/audio/fetch-music.mjs and are not committed (the artist asks that his music not be re-uploaded on its own). sha256 and bytes pin the exact files the mix was made with; 'analysis' is written by scripts/audio/analyze_music.py.

requirements: Credit the artist in the film's credits, the README and the YouTube description (his Smart Content ID reads the description).

Do not re-upload the music on its own and do not submit remixes to fingerprinting services.

alignment.verdict: same samples until 83 s of the main mix, where an equal-gain ('hsin') crossfade swaps them in place; after that the mixes differ: crossfade equal-power ('qsin') on a phrase boundary
alignment.method: normalised cross-correlation (mono, 6 s windows every 15 s, +-1 s); null = main minus aligned alt, BS.1770 loudness
